hero.title: Send dental lab orders without the chaos
hero.subtitle: Pick a lab, send a structured order with files and prices, track it to delivery, and keep every invoice in one place — so no case is ever dictated down a phone line again.

how.title: One structured order, start to finish
how.body: Four steps, about five minutes. You can stop after any of them — the order saves as a draft.

steps.title: Pick a laboratory
steps.body: Browse approved labs by city, service and turnaround. Every price is published up front.

steps.title: Fill the lab's own form
steps.body: Teeth on a map, shade from a picker, material from a list. Required fields can't be skipped.

steps.title: Attach scans, set the due date
steps.body: Digital impressions up to 100 MB per file, a requested due date, and rush if the lab offers it.

steps.title: Track it to delivery
steps.body: Confirmed price and due date from the lab, a status on every step, and the invoice at the end.

doctors.title: Order once, correctly, and see where every case stands

features.title: Tooth map instead of dictation
features.body: Mark units, pontics and implants visually — the lab receives exactly what you selected.

features.title: The price before you submit
features.body: A live breakdown per unit, with rush surcharge shown separately. The lab confirms the final figure.

features.title: Patients and case history
features.body: Every order filed under the patient, so a continuation starts from the last one instead of a blank page.

features.title: Changes on the record
features.body: Edit an open case with a reason; the lab sees a clear diff of what changed and re-prices if needed.

features.title: Invoice you or the clinic
features.body: Bill per work location, with clinic identification codes held on file for billing.

labs.title: Define the order form once — every order arrives complete

features.title: Your services, your form
features.body: Start from templates — crown & bridge, implants, milling, guides — and publish a form per service.

features.title: Pricing and turnaround you set
features.body: Per-unit and per-jaw pricing, minimum working days, optional rush surcharge — applied automatically.

features.title: One dashboard for intake
features.body: Accept, price and schedule incoming cases; flag an order as needing doctor input and the case waits, not your bench.

features.title: Staff assignment & Telegram chats
features.body: Assign technicians per order and open a group chat with the doctor when something needs a human answer.

features.title: Receivables, not guesswork
features.body: See who owes what, record payments, and keep finances behind a passcode lock.

items.a: Creating an account is free for doctors, clinics and laboratories. Each laboratory sets its own service prices, and the order shows them before you submit.
At this stage we work with digital impressions only — you attach scan files to the order. Conventional-impression workflows are on the roadmap.

items.q: How does a laboratory get listed?
items.a: Register, complete your legal and billing details, then submit for review. Once approved you appear in the doctors' lab directory and can publish services.

items.q: Can I change an order after sending it?
items.a: Yes, until the case is closed. You pick a reason for the change, the lab sees exactly what changed, and confirms whether the price or due date moves.
English, Georgian and Russian, switchable anywhere in the app — including the order forms your lab publishes.

cta.title: Your next case, ordered in five minutes
cta.body: Create an account and place your first order today — no contract, no setup fee.
